title: Five Candles on Pancake Hill
synopsis: Jack turns five at a Pine Park picnic. The friends give him the completed red science wagon, and after the birthday candles are blown out, a new picture arrives from Scout's Moon rover.
continuity_state: Before: Jack is nearly five and his Pine Park picnic is planned for today. The small red four-wheeled wagon is complete and concealed in Gus's large box. Rex and Molly, along with familiar adults, are ready. After: Jack is now exactly five years old; the five birthday candles have been blown out. He owns a red four-wheeled pull wagon for his notebook with a yellow Moon and four friend marks. His paper crown, blue ribbon and updated Moon rover photo come home; the rover continues working. No second rover or Moon visit occurs.
